notes.title: First Update Live!
notes.content:
We have received a ton of great feedback, including a few bug reports and many feature requests. We've been working hard to try to include as many fixes and feature requests as possible in this update!

[h1]New Content & Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]E.A.R.L. Letters:[/b] Find and collect the E.A.R.L. letters scattered throughout each environment! Search the map and use the environment to gather all four letters in a single run and you’ll be rewarded with coins and a brand-new vehicle. Unlock the new vehicles once per environment.
[*] [b]Steam Achievements:[/b] 19 Steam achievements are ready and waiting to be earned! Where possible, the game will check on startup whether any have been previously completed and automatically award them.
[*] [b]View Current Build:[/b] See which upgrades your vehicle has during and after each run by checking the pause and results menus. Some vehicles start with perks, so now it’s more obvious!
[*] [b]Trophies:[/b] Each level has three trophies that can be earned: Silver, Gold, and Platinum. Beat each level once on Casual, Gnarly, and Insane respectively to earn the trophies. Collect the same trophy for all environments and earn a celebration from Edna… and maybe an achievement.
[*] [b]Coin Hints:[/b] When earning extra coins for things like collecting the E.A.R.L. letters, a hint shows up near the coin balance indicating how many coins you earned.
[*] [b]Starting Vehicle Upgrades:[/b] Some vehicles now start with wheel spikes or extra boost upgrades!
[/list]

[h1]Bugs & Polish[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Only the first boss you play against has their pre-run cutscene play
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Missing localization text on one of the vehicle colors
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Units stop spawning on the Moab Desert and Frozen Salt Flats levels 2 minutes after the boss is spawned
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] After picking an in-run upgrade, if you quickly press Pause, the game resumes playing even though the Pause Menu is up
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] UI hover sounds play even when buttons are disabled
[*] [b]Added:[/b] Icons in the Level-Up Upgrade popup
[*] [b]Added:[/b] New voice SFX for bosses
[/list]

Hope you enjoy!

Colter, Dave, and Ed

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible!
notes.content:
As avid fans of the Steam Deck, we ensured that Earl vs. the Mutants was optimized for it from the start. From our first build on, we have tested the game on Steam Deck, mouse and keyboard, and Xbox and PlayStation controllers to accommodate as many players as possible.

If you have a Steam Deck, you'll find that Earl vs. the Mutants runs smoothly and provides a great gaming experience!

Let us know what you think!

Colter, Dave, and Ed

notes.title: Build 0.8.13 Live
notes.content:
[b]THANK YOU[/b]

A huge thanks to everyone who played our demo in the last 10 days! We're thrilled with the turnout and the valuable feedback you've provided.

We're eager to address as much of your feedback as we can with this week's build. Our priorities are enhancing stability, improving user experience for new players, and clarifying upgrade names and descriptions. We acknowledge there's more to do regarding the clarity of upgrades, and we're exploring some bigger ideas that we're exploring.

For now, here's what's in the build:

[b]=== FUNCTIONALITY UPDATES ===[/b]
-New players begin with 3 tutorial goals.
-Goals now follow an ordered list instead of a random selection, allowing better control over goal progression (no more "Reverse to the boss!" on your first try).
-Drone level-up upgrades now include drone names for clarity.
-Introduced debug logs in the bootup sequence to address loading issues on certain handheld devices.
-Added difficulty tracking in anonymous analytics system for a better understanding of win/loss rates across different levels.
-The first run always starts in the "default" spawn location, with the car facing upwards on the road.
-Main Menu now features a "Wishlist on Steam" button, with added graphics on the loading screen.


[b]=== BUG FIXES & TUNING ===[/b]
-Refined some upgrade names for greater clarity.
-Slowed the initial level-up pace by increasing XP requirements for early levels to reduce gameplay interruptions.
-Fixed erratic behavior in ranged units' targeting.
-Increased the size of health pack visuals.
-Enhanced barrel damage against enemies and bosses for more impactful gameplay.
-Disabled test localization functionality.

Thanks!

Colter, Dave, and Ed

notes.title: Demo Live!
notes.content:
We're super excited to announce that the Demo for Earl vs. the Mutants is live!

Last Thursday, January 18th, we pushed the demo live! We are thrilled with the number of people we've seen play the game both on Twitch and YouTube! We've also seen a ton of posts about the game on TikTok, Reddit, Facebook, and Instagram.

It's incredible getting so much feedback in such a short amount of time -- a little overwhelming, even, but in a good way! Over the weekend we sifted through all the notes we took from watching you all play, and compiled a list of bugs, new features, and improvements.

We've gotten loads of ideas for new vehicles, bosses, enemy types, gameplay modes, upgrades, etc. and we're putting them all on the board as things to consider for the full launch later this year.

For the next few weeks, our immediate focus is on polishing the demo as much as possible. If you have any ideas, please let us know!

<3
Colter, Dave, and Ed
